literal: On jiazi day, made Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui Northern Court Privy Commissioner, Prince of Bin Suige tiyin, enfeoffed tiyin Dirugu as Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner, and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner; Prince of Bin Suige was made tiyin; tiyin Dirugu was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner; and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.

literal: Flying Dragon stable horses were brought out and distributed among the ministers.
idiomatic: Flying Dragon stable horses were brought out and distributed among the ministers.

literal: Eleventh month, on dingchou day, posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Chu Xiao Xiaozhong as King of Chu.
idiomatic: On dingchou day of the eleventh month Prince of Chu Xiao Xiaozhong was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chu.

literal: On dinghai day, because the Upper Capital had a poor harvest, restored the people's land taxes.
idiomatic: On dinghai day, because the Upper Capital had a poor harvest, the people's land taxes were restored.

literal: On guisi day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On guisi day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: Twelfth month, on wushen day, changed the Political Affairs Department to the Zhongshu Department.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the twelfth month the Political Affairs Department was renamed the Zhongshu Department.

literal: Thirteenth year, spring, first month, on the jiazi new moon, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on the jiazi new moon of the first spring month, the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: On wuchen day, went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the court went to Huntong River.

literal: On xinwei day, hunted at Wulu Pavilion Ridge.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the court hunted at Wulu Pavilion Ridge.

literal: Second month, on gengxu day, went to Yu'er Marsh.
idiomatic: On gengxu day of the second month the court went to Yu'er Marsh.

literal: On bingchen day, made Associate Councilor Du Fang Southern Chancellor.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Associate Councilor Du Fang was appointed Southern Chancellor.

literal: Third month, on dinghai day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the third month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Made Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie Associate Councilor.
idiomatic: Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie was appointed Associate Councilor.

literal: That month, established Khitan patrol inspectorate.
idiomatic: That month a Khitan patrol inspectorate was established.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day, dispatched Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshi and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the fourth summer month Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshi and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi were dispatched to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.

literal: On jiayin day, Southern Court great king Yelü Gaoshi memorialized that Tangut and other tribes had rebelled and submitted to Xia State.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Southern Court great king Yelü Gaoshi memorialized that Tangut and other tribes had rebelled and submitted to Xia State.

literal: On bingchen day, Southwestern Route pacification inspector Luohan Nu, xiangwen Wulumu, and others memorialized that Western Mountain tribal military commissioner Qulie led five tribes in rebellion into Western Xia, requesting Northern and Southern Court troops to aid in escorting Shiwei Saizhou households.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Southwestern Route pacification inspector Luohan Nu, xiangwen Wulumu, and others memorialized that Western Mountain tribal military commissioner Qulie had led five tribes in rebellion into Western Xia and requested Northern and Southern Court troops to aid in escorting Shiwei Saizhou households.

literal: Edict ordered the wealthy to go; the remainder to stay and farm at Tiande Army.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the wealthy to go; the remainder were to stay and farm at Tiande Army.

literal: Fifth month, on the renxu new moon, Luohan Nu memorialized that dispatched tribal troops fought Tangut unfavorably; pacification commissioner Xiao Puda and Sijie Army xiangwen Zhang Fonu died in battle.
idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the fifth month Luohan Nu memorialized that dispatched tribal troops had fought Tangut unfavorably; pacification commissioner Xiao Puda and Sijie Army xiangwen Zhang Fonu died in battle.

literal: Li Yuanhao came to aid the rebels.
idiomatic: Li Yuanhao came to aid the rebels.

literal: On wuchen day, edict ordered mustering troops from all routes to assemble on the southwestern border to attack Yuanhao.
idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered troops from all routes mustered to assemble on the southwestern border to attack Yuanhao.

literal: Sixth month, on jiawu day, Zubu chieftain Wuba sent his son bringing Yuanhao's dispatched envoy seeking aid Woyigai, whom he had seized, requesting troops to aid in battle; approved.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the sixth month Zubu chieftain Wuba sent his son with Yuanhao's dispatched envoy seeking aid, Woyigai, whom he had seized, requesting troops to aid in battle; approval was granted.

literal: Halted at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: The court halted at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: Because about to attack Xia, dispatched Yongchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu to inform Song.
idiomatic: Because the court was about to attack Xia, Yongchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu was dispatched to inform Song.

literal: On bingshen day, edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Zhucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.
idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Zhucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.

literal: On bingwu day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On dingwei day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On dingwei day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou day, Xianghe county man Li Yier was executed for leading the people astray by heterodox practices.
idiomatic: On xinyou day of the seventh autumn month Xianghe county man Li Yier was executed for leading the people astray by heterodox practices.

literal: On gengwu day, performed the rebirth rite.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the rebirth rite was performed.

literal: On gengchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys to court.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Xia State sent envoys to court.

literal: Eighth month, on yiwei day, because the Xia envoy answered without sincerity, he was detained.
idiomatic: On yiwei day of the eighth month, because the Xia envoy answered without sincerity, he was detained.

literal: On dingsi day, Xia State again dispatched envoys; questioned on affairs and again answered untruthfully; flogged.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Xia State again sent envoys; when questioned on affairs they again answered untruthfully and were flogged.

literal: Ninth month, on wuchen day, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with funeral gifts.
idiomatic: On wuchen day of the ninth month, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with funeral gifts.

literal: On renshen day, assembled the great army at Ninety-nine Springs; Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern Court Privy Commissioner King of Han Xiao Hui commanded vanguard troops on a western expedition.
idiomatic: On renshen day the great army assembled at Ninety-nine Springs; Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern Court Privy Commissioner King of Han Xiao Hui commanded vanguard troops on a western expedition.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengyin day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the tenth winter month sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On bingshen day, captured Tangut scouts; shot ghost arrows.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Tangut scouts were captured and ghost arrows were shot.

literal: On dingyou day, Li Yuanhao submitted a memorial begging forgiveness.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Li Yuanhao submitted a memorial begging forgiveness.

literal: On jihai day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys memorializing that he wished to take back the rebels to present them; approved.
idiomatic: On jihai day Yuanhao sent envoys memorializing that he wished to take back the rebels and present them; approval was granted.

literal: On xinchou day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys presenting local products; edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Yuanhao sent envoys presenting local products; an edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.

literal: On renzi day, encamped at River Bend.
idiomatic: On renzi day the army encamped at River Bend.

literal: Ge reported Yuanhao was personally leading three Tangut tribes; edict ordered Ge to reproach him for accepting rebels and breaking the alliance; Yuanhao acknowledged guilt and was granted wine.
idiomatic: Xiao Ge reported that Yuanhao was personally leading three Tangut tribes; an edict ordered Ge to reproach him for accepting rebels and breaking the alliance; Yuanhao acknowledged guilt and was granted wine.

literal: Permitted him to reform; dispatched him.
idiomatic: He was permitted to reform and was dispatched.

literal: Summoned ministers for deliberation; all held that with the great army already assembled, attack should be pressed.
idiomatic: The ministers were summoned for deliberation; all held that with the great army already assembled, attack should be pressed.

literal: On guichou day, urged troops of several routes in a surprise raid, killing several thousand; imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hudu was captured by Xia.
idiomatic: On guichou day troops of several routes were urged in a surprise raid, killing several thousand; imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hudu was captured by Xia.

literal: On dingsi day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys returning those previously captured; edict ordered detained Xia envoys also returned to their state.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Yuanhao sent envoys returning those previously captured; an edict ordered detained Xia envoys also returned to their state.

literal: Eleventh month, on xinyou day, rewarded meritorious officers and soldiers in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On xinyou day of the eleventh month meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded in differing amounts.

literal: On jiazi day, withdrew the army.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the army withdrew.

literal: On dingmao day, changed Yun Prefecture to Western Capital.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Yun Prefecture was renamed Western Capital.

literal: On xinsi day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: Twelfth month, on jichou day, visited Western Capital.
idiomatic: On jichou day of the twelfth month the court visited Western Capital.

literal: On wuxu day, made Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Dilie right yilibi.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Dilie was appointed right yilibi.

literal: On jihai day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jihai day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On wushen day, Xiao Hudu returned from Xia.
idiomatic: On wushen day Xiao Hudu returned from Xia.

literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, on gengshen day, made Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed him Prince of Liaoxi.
idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on gengshen day of the first spring month, Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie was appointed Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed Prince of Liaoxi.

literal: On gengwu day, went to Yu'er Marsh.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the court went to Yu'er Marsh.

literal: On renwu day, made Jinwu Guard senior general Dirugu Yishi great king.
idiomatic: On renwu day Jinwu Guard senior general Dirugu was appointed Yishi great king.

literal: On jiashen day, Xia State dispatched envoys presenting cranes.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Xia State sent envoys presenting cranes.

literal: Because changshi Wogude died in battle, ordered his son Xiluo made commander.
idiomatic: Because changshi Wogude had died in battle, his son Xiluo was appointed commander.

literal: Second month, on gengzi day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the second month the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: Halted at Sala Marsh.
idiomatic: The court halted at Sala Marsh.

literal: Third month, on jimao day, because Song's Xia campaign army had returned, dispatched envoys to congratulate.
idiomatic: On jimao day of the third month, because Song's Xia campaign army had returned, envoys were dispatched to congratulate.

literal: Fourth month, on xinchou day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the fourth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Intercalary fifth month, on guichou day, summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the intercalary fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: Sixth month, on dingmao day, visited Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the sixth month the court visited Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On jimao day, Zubu great king Tuntugusi led chieftains to court.
idiomatic: On jimao day Zubu great king Tuntugusi led chieftains to court.

literal: On gengchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On xinsi day, because Southwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Puda died in battle, posthumously granted Associate Chief Councillor of the Central Secretariat.
idiomatic: On xinsi day, because Southwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Puda had died in battle, he was posthumously granted Associate Chief Councillor of the Central Secretariat.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wushen day, halted at Zhonghui River.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the seventh autumn month the court halted at Zhonghui River.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiazi day, performed distant sacrifice at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the tenth winter month distant sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.

literal: Eleventh month, on the renwu new moon, Uyghur Asalan dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the eleventh month Uyghur Asalan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiachen day, made concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala Northern Chancellor.
idiomatic: On jiachen day concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed Northern Chancellor.

literal: Twelfth month, on guichou day, observed Han troops drilling with artillery, crossbows, shooting, and thrusting.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the twelfth month Han troops were observed drilling with artillery, crossbows, shooting, and thrusting.

literal: On guihai day, cleared stagnant lawsuits.
idiomatic: On guihai day stagnant lawsuits were cleared.

literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, on yiyou day, went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on yiyou day of the first spring month, the court went to Huntong River.

literal: Forbade Khitan selling slave girls and boys to Han people.
idiomatic: Khitan were forbidden to sell slave girls and boys to Han people.

literal: Second month, on yimao day, went to Changchun River.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the second month the court went to Changchun River.

literal: On bingyin day, Puluhu Modu border Helan River households came to submit; edict ordered them settled.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Puluhu Modu border Helan River households came to submit; an edict ordered them settled.

literal: Third month, on jiashen day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the third month the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: On yiyou day, on the occasion of the Responding Sage Festival, commuted death sentences and released those below convict labor.
idiomatic: On yiyou day, on the occasion of the Responding Sage Festival, death sentences were commuted and those below convict labor were released.

literal: On xinmao day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: On dingyou day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Edict ordered all routes annually to submit lawsuit records for report.
idiomatic: An edict ordered all routes annually to submit lawsuit records for report.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on the xinhai new moon, forbade officials and commoners of the Five Capitals from playing cuju.
idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the fourth summer month officials and commoners of the Five Capitals were forbidden to play cuju.

literal: On wuwu day, abolished Yaolian Tent garrison troops.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Yaolian Tent garrison troops were abolished.

literal: On renxu day, made Northern Jurchen xiangwen Xiao Gaoliu King of the Xi Six Tribes.
idiomatic: On renxu day Northern Jurchen xiangwen Xiao Gaoliu was appointed King of the Xi Six Tribes.

literal: On jiazi day, summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: On jiaxu day, one hundred eighty Puluhu Modu Helan River households came to submit.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day one hundred eighty Puluhu Modu Helan River households came to submit.

literal: Sixth month, on guichou day, made Western Capital regent Yelü Maliu Han mobile palace deployment director and Associate Councilor Yang Jie sent out as Wuding Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the sixth month Western Capital regent Yelü Maliu was appointed Han mobile palace deployment director, and Associate Councilor Yang Jie was sent out as Wuding Army military commissioner.

literal: On wuchen day, attended the Cool Hall and tested jinshi; granted rank to sixty-eight including Wang Tang and below.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the Emperor attended the Cool Hall, tested jinshi, and granted rank to sixty-eight including Wang Tang and below.

literal: On jiaxu day, Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Yelü Dirugu was removed from office for corruption.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Yelü Dirugu was removed from office for corruption.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yiyou day, Prince of Bin Suige died.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the seventh autumn month Prince of Bin Suige died.

literal: On wuzi day, observed the harvest.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the court observed the harvest.

literal: On yiwei day, made Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Lü Fen left yilibi and former Southern Chancellor Yelü Xisun Northeast Route xiangwen.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Lü Fen was appointed left yilibi, and former Southern Chancellor Yelü Xisun was made Northeast Route xiangwen.

literal: On bingshen day, registered troops on all routes.
idiomatic: On bingshen day troops on all routes were registered.

literal: On dingyou day, went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: On xinchou day, forbade attendants from trampling commoners' fields.
idiomatic: On xinchou day attendants were forbidden from trampling commoners' fields.

literal: On dingwei day, because Jurchen tribal chief Zhemu led his multitude to submit, promoted to grand preceptor.
idiomatic: On dingwei day, because Jurchen tribal chief Zhemu had led his multitude to submit, he was promoted to grand preceptor.

literal: Eighth month, on guichou day, Goryeo King Qin died; envoys dispatched to announce.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the eighth month Goryeo King Qin died, and envoys were dispatched to announce it.

literal: Ninth month, on jiachen day, forbade using snare nets to catch foxes and hares.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the ninth month using snare nets to catch foxes and hares was forbidden.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiyou day, halted at Zhonghui River.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghui River.
